{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Baltanos — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Baltanos]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Baltanos]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Baltanos]]'s Engineer services in Deriso.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Baltanos is independently available and does not require a referral from another Engineer.
* '''Invitation:''' There is no separate invitation requirement distinct from the unlock requirement below.
* Reach '''Friendly''' reputation with the '''Colonia Council'''.
}}
== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Reach '''Friendly''' reputation with the '''Colonia Council'''.
# Travel to The Divine Apparatus in Deriso.
# Confirm access at the Engineer's terminal.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Baltanos]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
